# README assets

These compositions are generated by
[`packages/brand/scripts/readme-assets.mjs`](../../../packages/brand/scripts/readme-assets.mjs).
The Index Dots mark, outlined Figtree wordmark, and Emerald Reserve palette
come directly from `@cadencr/brand`.

## Product sources

Captured on **2026-10-22 from CadencR v0.14.1**, at repository revision
`d68748f76`. All three images show the actual application, loaded with
illustrative conversations in an isolated demonstration database. Conversation
text, code, token counts, and pending gates are example data; they are not
customer activity or evidence of an agent's measured performance.

The images focus on the core agent workflow: supervising several conversations,
handling requests, and steering an individual agent. The source WebPs are
lossless encodings of the screenshots. The generator only resizes and frames
them; it does not redraw controls or alter their content.

| Output          | Dimensions  | Source                                                                                                                                   |
| --------------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `hero.png`      | 1680 × 1207 | [`agents.webp`](./source/v0.14.1/agents.webp): four providers in the unified agent grid, across two projects.                            |
| `attention.png` | 1680 × 1147 | [`permission.webp`](./source/v0.14.1/permission.webp): a permission checkpoint and the For me queue.                                     |
| `review.png`    | 1680 × 1147 | [`conversation.webp`](./source/v0.14.1/conversation.webp): a focused conversation with rendered code, model controls, and context usage. |

## Refresh

1. Capture the current application using an isolated workspace and clearly
   labeled example conversations. Keep the unified agent grid, attention queue,
   and conversation workflow as the subjects.
2. Use the app's grid controls to arrange readable panes. Dismiss transient
   notifications and hover popovers before capture. Do not reconstruct the UI.
3. Store lossless source captures in a new versioned `source/` directory and
   update the source directory in the generator.
4. Regenerate and check:

   ```bash
   pnpm --filter @cadencr/brand readme:install
   pnpm --filter @cadencr/brand readme:check
   ```

5. Inspect the rendered README at desktop and mobile widths. Keep versions,
   dimensions, alt text, captions, and this inventory consistent.

All three PNGs are committed so GitHub can display them without a build.
The brand package's tests detect missing or stale output.
